subject_rule: Mixed by call: the Master's call is open to all academic disciplines and the summer courses are open to students and graduates in any subject area; the STEM Master's call is limited to mathematics, computer science, natural sciences and engineering (interdisciplinary programmes need a designated STEM focus); the EPOS call funds only the development-related courses on its list. The doctoral, research-grant and cotutelle calls state no subject limit and have separate rules for human medicine, veterinary medicine and dentistry.

Doctoral Programmes, Research Grants and Cotutelle: no list of subjects or programmes is published; the host is an individual supervisor or a structured doctoral programme chosen by the applicant. Levels are not listed because there are no programme rows.

The list holds 85 course rows (one per level or period) and all are recorded; the call page states no total.
